wines.name: Love in a Bottle
wines.description: A sweet, refreshing blend of juicy peaches and ripe blueberries. Bright, fruity and easy to enjoy, Love in a Bottle is our best-selling wine and a customer favorite for celebrations, gatherings or simply relaxing at home.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with fruit-forward desserts, soft cheeses, brunch, picnics or on its own.

wines.name: Christmas in a Bottle
wines.description: A festive, sweet grape wine filled with warm holiday flavor. Smooth and comforting, Christmas in a Bottle brings the spirit of the season to holiday meals, family gatherings and cozy evenings.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with holiday desserts, baked ham, roasted nuts, sharp cheeses or by the fire.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Deep ruby red with bright, shimmering clarity. AROMA Cinnamon, clove and orange zest, with hints of vanilla and dried fruit. TASTE Sweet red berries, warm holiday spices and a touch of citrus. Smooth and velvety with a comforting vanilla-spice finish.

wines.name: Peach
wines.description: Made with real peach juice, this sweet fruit wine captures the juicy, sun-ripened flavor of fresh peaches. Bright, smooth and easy to enjoy, it brings a taste of summer to every glass.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with spicy dishes, grilled chicken, glazed ham, soft cheeses or peach cobbler.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Clear, pale golden color with soft peach highlights. AROMA Fresh, ripe peach aromas with delicate floral notes. TASTE Juicy peach flavor with natural sweetness and light acidity. Smooth and refreshing with a clean, lingering peach finish.

wines.name: Strawberry
wines.description: Made with real strawberry juice, this sweet fruit wine is filled with the bright flavor of ripe strawberries. Smooth, fruity and easy to enjoy, it brings fresh berry character to every glass.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with spicy dishes, grilled chicken, soft cheeses, cheesecake or chocolate desserts.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Clear, rosy red color with bright ruby highlights. AROMA Fresh, ripe strawberry aromas with a delicate floral lift. TASTE Juicy strawberry flavor with natural sweetness and gentle acidity. Smooth and refreshing with a clean berry finish.

wines.name: Blackberry
wines.description: Made with real blackberry juice, this sweet fruit wine is full of ripe dark-berry flavor. Smooth, juicy and easy to enjoy, it offers rich fruit character with a pleasantly sweet finish.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with barbecue, roasted pork, soft cheeses, cheesecake or rich chocolate desserts.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Deep ruby-purple with bright, clear highlights. AROMA Inviting aromas of ripe blackberries with a hint of dark fruit. TASTE Juicy blackberry flavor with balanced sweetness and gentle acidity. Smooth and rich with a lingering berry finish.

wines.name: Blueberry
wines.description: Made with real blueberry juice, this sweet fruit wine is full of ripe dark-berry flavor. Smooth, juicy and easy to enjoy, it offers rich fruit character with a pleasantly sweet finish.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with barbecue, mild cheeses, fresh fruit, cheesecake or rich chocolate desserts.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Deep ruby-violet with bright, clear highlights. AROMA Inviting aromas of ripe blueberries with a hint of fresh fruit. TASTE Juicy blueberry flavor with balanced sweetness and gentle acidity. Smooth and refreshing with a lingering berry finish.

wines.name: Autumn in a Bottle
wines.description: A festive seasonal grape wine filled with warm pumpkin-spice flavor. Sweet, smooth and comforting, Autumn in a Bottle brings the familiar taste of fall to every glass.
wines.serving: Lightly chilled or at room temperature
wines.pairings: Enjoy with pumpkin or pecan pie, baked ham, roasted pork, sharp cheeses or by itself on a cool fall evening.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Deep ruby red with warm garnet highlights. AROMA Inviting aromas of cinnamon, nutmeg and clove with ripe grape fruit. TASTE Sweet, smooth grape flavor layered with warm baking spices and a soft, lingering pumpkin-spice finish.

wines.name: Lumbee River Red
wines.description: A sweet red blend of blueberry, blackberry and strawberry wines. Smooth, fruit-forward and easy to enjoy, Lumbee River Red brings together juicy berry flavors with a pleasantly sweet finish.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with barbecue, smoked pork, burgers, mild cheeses, berry desserts or rich chocolate.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Deep ruby red with bright, clear highlights. AROMA Inviting aromas of ripe blueberry, blackberry and strawberry. TASTE Juicy mixed-berry flavor with balanced sweetness and gentle acidity. Smooth and refreshing with a lingering fruit finish.
wines.review_notes: Source heading says sweet fruit wine; TYPE says red table wine. Confirm product classification before publishing it.

wines.name: White Sangria
wines.description: A bright, sweet tropical wine with juicy pineapple and ripe mango flavors. Refreshing and easy to enjoy, White Sangria brings a sunny fruit character to gatherings, celebrations and warm afternoons.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with seafood, grilled chicken, spicy dishes, fresh fruit or light desserts.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Bright golden yellow with clear, sunny highlights. AROMA Inviting aromas of ripe pineapple and juicy mango. TASTE Sweet tropical fruit flavors with a lively, refreshing finish that is smooth and easy to enjoy.

wines.name: Carolina Crisp
wines.description: A bright, sweet apple wine with the fresh flavor of crisp orchard apples. Smooth, refreshing and easy to enjoy, Carolina Crisp delivers juicy apple character in every glass.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with pork, grilled chicken, sharp cheddar, fresh salads, apple pie or a simple cheese board.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Clear, pale gold with bright straw highlights. AROMA Fresh apple aromas with hints of orchard blossom. TASTE Juicy apple flavor with balanced sweetness and light acidity. Smooth and refreshing with a clean, crisp finish.

wines.name: Noble Sweet
wines.description: A traditional sweet red wine made from the Noble grape, a dark-skinned muscadine grown in the South. Rich grape flavor and an easy, smooth finish make it a welcoming choice for gatherings or relaxed sipping.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with barbecue, smoked pork, sharp cheese, pecan pie, berry cobbler or dark chocolate.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Deep ruby-purple with bright clarity. AROMA Ripe dark grapes with gentle berry and floral notes. TASTE Sweet, full grape flavor with soft acidity and a smooth, fruit-forward finish.

wines.name: Carlos Sweet
wines.description: A traditional Southern sweet wine with ripe Carlos muscadine character. Bright golden fruit, gentle floral notes and a smooth, easy finish make it equally welcoming at the table or enjoyed on its own.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with barbecue, roasted pork, mild cheeses, fresh fruit, pound cake or peach cobbler.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Pale gold with bright clarity. AROMA Ripe muscadine, fresh grape and soft floral notes. TASTE Sweet, juicy grape flavor with gentle acidity and a clean, smooth finish.

wines.name: Watermelon Wine
wines.description: A fun, sweet fruit wine bursting with juicy watermelon character. Light, smooth and refreshing, it captures the easygoing flavor of summer in every chilled glass.
wines.pairings: Enjoy with barbecue, grilled chicken, spicy dishes, fresh fruit, mild cheeses, picnic fare or light summer desserts.
wines.tasting_notes: APPEARANCE Clear, pale blush with delicate pink highlights. AROMA Fresh-cut watermelon with a soft candy-fruit lift. TASTE Juicy watermelon flavor, gentle sweetness and light acidity, finishing smooth and refreshing.
